summary: Implementation matches the saved P0 pre-GKE orphan-resource plan: read-only detection covers AWF Docker containers, networks, volumes, and managed ws_* worktrees; resources are classified against active, terminal, missing, and unavailable workspace views; service status preserves the legacy orphan_workspaces payload while exposing checks.orphan_resources; /readyz and /v1/metrics/resources/saturation expose structured cleanup readiness and injectable test seams; confirmed orphans fail readiness/status while DB, Docker, and worktree scan failures degrade to structured unavailable/unknown payloads. No destructive cleanup behavior was added. Validation passed: focused orphan/status/health/metrics tests, ruff, mypy, full unit tests, and coverage at 99.01%.
